title: Pioneer Talent Program - Full Stack AI Engineer, Fronted Oriented (Top Talent Program)
description: Binance is a leading global blockchain ecosystem behind the world’s largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume and registered users. We are trusted by 300+ million people in 100+ countries for our industry-leading security, user fund transparency, trading engine speed, deep liquidity, and an unmatched portfolio of digital-asset products. Binance offerings range from trading and finance to education, research, payments, institutional services, Web3 features, and more. We leverage the power of digital assets and blockchain to build an inclusive financial ecosystem to advance the freedom of money and improve financial access for people around the world. We are looking for a Full Stack Software Engineer with strong cross-platform engineering capabilities to join our team and build next-generation AI-powered products. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in at least one core technology stack, while also having hands-on experience across multiple layers of the product stack, including Backend, Web, Android, and/or iOS. Beyond traditional full-stack development, we are particularly interested in engineers who have experience with AI Agents, LLM applications, or AI-assisted product development, and who can independently take a product from technical design through implementation and production. This is a highly cross-functional engineering role, where you will work across different technology stacks and business scenarios depending on product needs. The strongest candidates will demonstrate: Deep expertise in one stack + hands-on experience across other stacks + strong AI/Agent capability + the ability to learn and ship independently. For example: Strong Java Backend + Web + AI Agent experience → Strong fit Strong Web + Android/iOS + AI Agent experience → Strong fit Strong Android/iOS + Backend/Web + AI Agent experience → Strong fit Strong in only one stack with no meaningful cross-platform exposure → Lower priority Broad technology exposure but limited production ownership → Lower priority
